title: Candle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='34' y='42' width='10' height='42' rx='5' fill='#FFD633'/>

  <rect x='54' y='46' width='6' height='34' rx='3' fill='#FFF5B8'/>

  <rect x='48' y='34' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#8B7355'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#FFB347' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- flame outer -->
  <path d='M50 8 Q58 18 58 26 Q58 34 50 34 Q42 34 42 26 Q42 18 50 8 Z' fill='#FF8C00'/>

  <path d='M43 66 Q50 73 57 66' stroke='#5C3A1E' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9999' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- candle plate/base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#D4A76A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#E8C98A'/>
